notes: AN APP THAT WOULD NOT QUIT. This release fixes a fault that could leave the application running with no window and refusing to close. To store your email password safely the app asks the operating system whether its keychain is available — and that question is answered by macOS itself, which the first time a newly installed copy asks puts up its OWN dialog and stops the app until somebody answers it. If the app has no window open at that moment, the dialog has nothing to appear over and nobody can answer it. The app is then left running with no window, ignoring every request to close, and only a forced quit ends it. From the outside it looks exactly like an app you have already closed — until the next thing that needs it finds it still there. TWO CHANGES MAKE THAT IMPOSSIBLE. The question is now asked only when there is something to do: it was being asked on every single launch to perform a one-time repair that has already been done, or was never needed, on virtually every installation. The app now checks its own records first and reaches for the keychain only if a password genuinely needs sealing, which for almost everyone is never. And the question is never asked while no window is open — every place in the app that consults the keychain now goes through one gate that refuses to ask when there is nothing on screen to answer. WHAT YOU WILL NOTICE. Almost certainly nothing, which is the point. If your copy has been showing a keychain prompt on launch it should stop. Nothing about how passwords are stored has changed and no stored password needs re-entering. One deliberate exception: if the app ever does need the keychain with no window open it now says so plainly instead of guessing — it will not tell you a password was sealed on another machine when the real reason was that no window was open, and it will never quietly store a password unsealed because it could not ask. CARRIES EVERYTHING IN THE PREVIOUS RELEASE, including the capital allowance schedule, unchanged. NO DATA CHANGES — this installs straight over the previous version. Please still take a backup first: Backup & Export, Back up now.
